name: KINS 1160
title: Courses in Lifetime Sports Program
description: A variety of lifetime sports and skills are offered. The teaching of each activity will be geared to individual, dual, and team activities. Students who have physical disabilities in the least restrictive environment possible. Participants requiring accommodations should contact the Program Coordinator. May be repeated for credit.
requirement_description: This course may be repeated with change of activity and/or skill level, not to exceed 3 credits toward graduation of combined AH 1200 and KINS 1160 credits. Students in the Dept. of Kinesiology may count up to 6 different activities for 6 credits.
